method: read live in the owner's Chrome, one tab per store, identity asserted before reading anything
question: Does this source say a discount is LIVE, and does it say when it ENDS?

results.identity_asserted: retailerLocation 531573, zoneId 917, postalCode 68136, 'Audrey' present, 'Des Moines' absent; header reads In-Store
results.how: Apollo item carries priceString $5.99 alongside fullPriceString $7.99, plus badge.badgeVariant='sale' and badge.offerLabelString='25% off'
proof_of_absence: badge carries 19 keys and not one is date/expiry/valid related
no key on the discounted item matches /date|expir|end|valid|until|thru|remain|time/
the entire Apollo cache holds two date-shaped values (2026-08-21, 2026-08-11), neither a promo window
results.card_text_sample: Current price: $5.99 | $599 | Original Price: $7.99 | 25% off | Truly Yours Premium Alfredo Pasta Sauce | 18 oz | Aisle 6
results.note: the glued '$599' beside the correct $5.99 is the known extractor defect; the authoritative 'Current price:' line is what must be parsed

results.identity_asserted: header reads In-Store; store label 'ALDI - OLA 48 - Omaha'
results.how: same Instacart storefront platform as Fareway: fullPriceString / Original Price / strikethrough / itemPromotions all present in the Apollo cache
proof_of_absence: zero keys matching /EndDate|Expir|ValidUntil/ anywhere in the Apollo cache
only date-shaped values are 2026-08-21 and 2026-08-05, neither a promo window
results.card_text_sample: Current price: $1.85 | $185 | Millville Fruit Rounds | 12.2 oz | Many in stock | Cereal
results.note: OLA 48, not the OLA 42 in older notes - the store id changed 2026-08-15 and the memory records it

results.identity_asserted: walmart.com, no bot interstitial, 60 items returned
results.how: priceInfo.wasPrice ($5.96 against a $4.87 line price), savings 'SAVE $1.09', savingsAmt 1.09, and a ROLLBACK badge flag
proof_of_absence: the ROLLBACK badge carries exactly __typename, key, text, type, id, styleId - nothing temporal
promoData holds only an AFFIRM financing entry; promoDiscount is null
annualEvent false, earlyAccessEvent false, eventAttributes {priceFlip:false, specialBuy:false}
the only date-ish item keys are streetDate / releaseDate / deliveryDate, none of which describe a price
results.sample: Tillamook Extra Creamy Salted Butter Sticks 4ct 16oz: $4.87, was $5.96
results.note: a rollback is therefore a REAL discount with no published window - the 30-day figure would be a TTL, not a date the store gave us

results.identity_asserted: page reads 'Omaha Sam's Club'; no bot interstitial
results.how: strikethrough and wasPrice both present in __NEXT_DATA__
proof_of_absence: zero date-shaped values in the entire payload
every key matching /Expir/ is session, cache or consent related (tempoCacheExpirationInSeconds, payAtStoreExpiryHours, uxconPartialConsentedExpiry, ...) - none is a price window
results.note: 'Instant Savings' did not appear for this term; absence of the phrase here is not proof it never carries a window, and is recorded as untested rather than negative
